scenario.title: The Nguyens: family townhouse with a cat and a courtyard
scenario.room: Open-plan family living and kitchen area: L-shaped sofa, kids' toys on the rug, low shelves with plants, sliding door to a small courtyard

suggestions.name: English Cocker Spaniel
suggestions.reason: Gentle and eager to please, this dog fits your moderate exercise and family routine.
suggestions.watch_out: Introduce carefully to your cat and supervise early interactions around the home.

suggestions.name: Field Spaniel
suggestions.reason: Trainable and friendly, this breed matches your daily exercise routine and family setup.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan slow, supervised introductions with your resident cat from day one.

suggestions.name: Standard Schnauzer
suggestions.reason: Smart and adaptable, it fits well into a home with minimal time spent alone.
suggestions.watch_out: Manage potential chase instincts with your cat using clear boundaries.

suggestions.name: Barbet
suggestions.reason: Patient and companionable, this dog suits a lively home with older children well.
suggestions.watch_out: Maintain consistent grooming and ensure gradual introductions to your family cat.

suggestions.name: Eurasier
suggestions.reason: Calm and even-tempered, it easily fits a household with older children and courtyard space.
suggestions.watch_out: Provide gentle, supervised exposure to your cat during the settling period.

suggestions.name: Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Quiet and peaceful, this low-key dog adapts smoothly to your family's daily rhythm.
suggestions.watch_out: Keep daily walks relaxed to avoid overheating in warmer weather.

suggestions.name: French Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Though smaller than preferred, its companionable nature fits your home atmosphere perfectly.
suggestions.watch_out: Offered as a smaller option due to its great fit for your household.

suggestions.name: Basset Hound
suggestions.reason: Laid-back and affectionate, this breed fits your moderate activity and family setting well.
suggestions.watch_out: Manage potential baying to keep close neighbours happy.

room_check.line: It can work with a few changes. They're listed below, most important first.
room_check.summary: Bright open-plan living area and kitchen with wood flooring, a central area rug, and sliding glass doors opening to a private outdoor patio.
hazards: Small toys on living room rug (medium)
what_to_change: Move the pothos plant off the low shelf to prevent accidental ingestion.
Place small toy pieces into covered storage bins when not in use.
Elevate cat food bowls onto a higher counter away from the dog.
